core.title: Steel Security Wrap-Around Deadbolt Door Plates - 1-1/2 Hole

text.description_html:
Steel Security Wrap-Around Deadbolt Door Plates CW - 1-1/2 Hole

Protect your doors from entry tools and tampering with this steel wrap around security door plate. This plate is designed to protect and wrap around a Deadbolt installation.

Specifications for the DJO-CW:

  • Steel or stainless steel (.032 gauge) construction
  • 4 finishes available
  • Built-in stainless steel threaded insert for latch
  • Long lasting and secure mounting of latch and bolt
  • Heavy duty stainless steel trim screws
  • Permanent holding power eliminates loosening of latch mounting screws

Available in 4 Sizes:

    5-CW:
    • Door thickness: 1-3/8"
    • Backset: 2-3/8"
    • Height: 4-1/2"
    • Width: 4"
    • Bore Hole Diameter: 1-1/2"
    • Edge Bore 1"

    6-CW:
    • Door thickness: 1-3/4"
    • Backset: 2-3/8"
    • Height: 4-1/2"
    • Width: 4"
    • Bore Hole Diameter: 1-1/2"
    • Edge Bore 1"

    7-CW:
    • Door thickness: 1-3/8"
    • Backset: 2-3/4"
    • Height: 4-1/2"
    • Width: 4-1/4"
    • Bore Hole Diameter: 1-1/2"
    • Edge Bore 1"

    8-CW:
    • Door thickness: 1-3/4"
    • Backset: 2-3/4"
    • Height: 4-1/2"
    • Width: 4-1/4"
    • Bore Hole Diameter: 1-1/2"
    • Edge Bore 1"
